truthNotes: Construction against prism-riviere-bracelet__pack.jpg and __detail.jpg: across the wrist Y A P Y A P Y A P, 9 visible (7 full, 2 foreshortened at the wrist's edges); three pastels, no two neighbours the same, no fourth colour. Square cushion cut, four claws where visible, each stone in its own single row of fine clear pavé, linked edge to edge; the fold-over clasp is under the wrist, out of view. Not a morph.

Silver tone: metal and pavé median L* 90.6, a* 1, b* -1, neutral, no gold cast. Stone hues against the detail ref: aqua 221 deg (ref 208), pink 345 deg (ref 8; cooler, but C* 15 at L* 76 reads soft pink, not lilac), yellow 87 deg (ref 84).

Logged, not a fail: the colour order is a strict three-colour cycle, which the real piece does not run (products.md flag), and at the two foreshortened ends the link sides show pavé texture where the ref's link sides are plain polished metal. Both are visible only at 3x zoom.

Scale: central 1.19x (pitch / wrist 0.160 at a 6.0 cm wrist), inside the 1.2x drop line by a hair. The b02 skeptic's 0.149-0.152 took the wrist as the vertical extent x cos 28 deg; both forearm edges measure 32-34 deg, which gives a wrist of 384-392 px, not 410-420.

Face rule: pass. The frame holds only a forearm and hand: no eyes, no face. Mehendi on the back of the hand and fingers only, ending before the wrist bone; no other jewellery; one plain nail at the fingertip, no nail art.
Pre-launch: re-read Prism stock before launch. It read 39 at the b04 pre-flight (41 on 19 Nov at 15:25); do not launch below 20.

Scale, full range (critic B, round 1): 1.09x / 1.19x / 1.28x at a 5.5 / 6.0 / 6.5 cm wrist, with the stone count giving 1.1-1.2x. Truth rests on the 1.2x drop line, so no copy may imply size; the round 1 Feed headline implies none. The lead logs the same range in the ledger row.

gate200.evidence: At 200 px the bracelet is the brightest, highest-contrast shape in the frame at every P tested (10, 25, 30, 40, 55, 70, 85, 100). Its pavé reads about Y 213 on skin of Y 92 (4.5:1), against the arm's Y 92 on velvet of Y 8 (3.0:1). A centre-surround saliency map at 200 px peaks inside the bracelet's box at every P (P 30: peak at Feed 670, 664); the box holds 28-30% of the top 2% of saliency on 3.9% of the area, at 3.5-4.1x the mean of the rest of the frame. The arm is the largest shape (24% of the Feed area) and the second read. b02's failure was the reverse: the hair was the highest-contrast mass and the gold hoops matched the apricot ground.
gate200.risk: The width share (16.8%) is under the b03 worn-detail target of 18%, though over the PLAYBOOK 4 floor of 12%. The bracelet is small at 216 px, about 36 px wide. Both critics must say the bracelet lands first on the blind sheet. Round 1: A says the bracelet lands first only narrowly (a white glint; the arm is the first shape); B says the arm lands first. The round 1 headline gives the thumb a reason; it has not been re-tested.
